description: Insert one or multiple new records into an entity type. Mutates data, enforcing row/field permissions and workspace tariff limits. Pass `item` for a single record OR `items` for batch insertion (do not pass both). Custom tables typically require `displayname`—call `get_table` first to check required fields. Bulk inserts are non-atomic: each row is processed independently and the response returns `{ count, items: [{ status: 'ok', item }], errors: [{ status: 'error', index, message }] }`. Use `update_rows` to modify existing records.

item.description: Single row payload to insert (use either `item` or `items`, not both).

items.description: Array of row payloads to insert in batch mode (use either `items` or `item`).

returnFields.description: Optional list of field names to include in each returned `item`.

name: create_rows
